Case note: Petition No. 1258/2024
Client: Vivek Sandhu (journalist, Chennai)
Opposing party: Shruti Karve
Court: Family Court at Chennai
Filed on: 11/12/2024
Claim amount: ₹79,60,000
Issue: divorce by mutual consent. The wife wants her jewellery and gifts returned.
Advice given: List the stridhan items to be returned in the settlement deed.
Outcome: The stridhan items were returned before the decree.
Recommended next step: Sign the receipt for the returned items.
